description:
The rest of an answer that was too long for one reply. An answer that continues says so at the top and ends with a cursor; each part carries items with `at` (where in the answer they belong) and `from` (the position the first one takes there), and names the cursor for the part after it.

Lists are best first, so the first reply already holds the strongest — but do not conclude from it alone: read every part before you answer about everybody.

A cursor lasts a day. Expired, it answers that it is gone: ask the question again.

Free.

cursor.description: The cursor the answer ended with (`more: …`), or the one the last part named.
